verdict.rationale: Restate's docs mention service 'versioning' only in the narrow sense of pinning in-flight requests/retries to the same deployed endpoint version (restate-docs-24), not a user-facing capability to version, review, or roll back automations/workflows. No evidence of a change-history UI, diffing, approval/review workflow, or rollback-to-prior-version feature for automations exists in the pack.
